prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Discover Your Perfect Desktop Companion", "Answer 3 quick questions to match with a companion tailored to your daily workflow.", "Select your work vibe"]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Learn simple mouse actions and shortcuts to interact with your pet."]
2: ["Upload Clear Photos for Best Results", "Ensure high lighting and front-facing photos so your pet model renders cleanly."]
3: ["Secure Your Pet & Save Your Cloud Progress", "Sign in now to ensure your desktop companion and saved data remain backed up forever."]
4: ["Summoning Your Desktop Companion...", "We are preparing your pet's animations. If render takes long, verify desktop overlay permissions."]
5: ["Select Idle Mode for low RAM usage, or Companion Mode for full interactive desktop chat."]
6: ["Link Account to Keep Your Desktop Pet Safe", "Signing in ensures your pet's personality, stats, and custom items are backed up safely to the cloud."]
7: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Sign your certificate to unlock your free starter accessory pack!", "Includes Free Starter Crown"]
8: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Scroll down to see how your new companion interacts with your open apps and daily tasks."]
9: ["Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Use quick tray controls if your pet ever hides behind active windows.", "Tip: Right-click the system tray icon anytime to bring your pet back to focus."]
